story.title: Run Sylvan Park and Richland Creek Greenway
paragraphs: The 20th Annual Richland Creek Run is listed for Saturday, April 4, 2026 in Nashville. The race leads participants from The Cohn Learning Center through sections of historic Sylvan Park and along the Richland Creek Greenway.
Net proceeds benefit Greenways for Nashville, a nonprofit dedicated to creating, preserving, and promoting greenways across Nashville and Davidson County.
The event includes a 5 Miler, a 1-Miler Fun Run, and the Dinky Dash for children ages 12 and under, giving families multiple ways to take part in the morning.

faqs.question: Where does the race start?
faqs.answer: The official listing says the 5 mile run begins outside The Cohn Learning Center at 4805 Park Avenue in Nashville and finishes back at Cohn.

faqs.question: Is online registration open?
faqs.answer: RunSignup currently shows online registration as closed/ended for the 5 Miler, 1-Miler Fun Run, and Dinky Dash. Runners should check the official RunSignup page for the latest status.

faqs.question: Are dogs and strollers allowed?
faqs.answer: The official event description says dogs and strollers are permitted during the race.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: The RunSignup refund policy page states that all fees are non-refundable and non-transferable.

faqs.question: What do 5 mile participants receive?
faqs.answer: The event description says all 5 mile participants receive a T-shirt, but T-shirts and/or sizing are not guaranteed for late registrants.

faqs.question: Who does the race benefit?
faqs.answer: Net proceeds benefit Greenways for Nashville, a nonprofit dedicated to creating, preserving, and promoting greenways in Nashville and Davidson County.

uncertainty.summary: Visible public RunSignup pages confirm the date, location, distances, start times, age eligibility for 5 Miler and Dinky Dash, schedule, refund policy, dog/stroller policy, beneficiary, sponsor tiers, and accommodation/contact email. Current pricing is not visible because online registration is closed/ended, and the direct race-director email is not public beyond the RunSignup contact form and the accommodation email listed by Team Magic. 1-Miler source pages conflict between 8:10 AM structured Event/Schedule data and approximately 8:05am descriptive prose; this mockup uses 8:10 AM from Event/Schedule. Steve confirmed this should be pitched as a preview/concept ahead of the 2027 date; visible date/pricing facts remain sourced from the currently posted April 4, 2026 RunSignup page until next-year details post.
